name: What is the typical process for a railing repair project with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a railing repair project with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical process for a railing repair project with Frasheski Construction begins with an initial site visit to assess the damage and discuss your needs. Following this, we provide a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, materials, and estimated timeline. Once approved, our team schedules the repair, which involves carefully addressing structural issues, replacing damaged components, and ensuring the railing meets safety standards. We manage the project from start to finish, keeping you informed at each stage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves an assessment, detailed proposal, scheduling, and expert execution of repairs, with project management throughout.
